item.title: About
item.description:
I am a PhD Student in Biostatistics at the University of Iowa.

My undergraduate degree was in Financial Mathematics, and I previously worked as a Quantitative Researcher, focusing on high-frequency trading. My current research interests include Clinical Trials (dose selection and optimization, seamless phase designs, and patient-focused drug development), Bayesian Methods (Bayesian adaptive designs and Bayesian borrowing), and Causal Inference (indirect comparisons, principal stratification, covariate adjustment, and surrogate endpoint validation). Some of these topics are related to my current work as a research assistant or will be explored in my dissertation research.
